description: Shows where one UK bill is now: its current stage and house with sitting dates, whether it has become an Act, been withdrawn or defeated, its long title and its sponsoring members and departments. Answers "where is the X bill now", "has it passed" and "who introduced it". Source: UK Parliament Bills API. Needs the bill ID from bill_search; it does not predict when a bill will pass. (cost: 1 credit)

billId.description: integer, required, the Parliament bill ID (from bill_search), e.g. 3462

name: bill_status
